registration_notice.title: Review your information before confirming
registration_notice.message:
You must verify that all information is correct and click Confirm and Submit for registration to be completed. If any information is incorrect, return and edit it before confirming.

After registering, always check your registration status using the email address you registered with via the ‘Check Registration Status’ button on the home page. If your name is not listed, contact staff immediately at 053-948-078.
